name: M3_MNS150MI_GetUserData
description: This tool can retrieve information about user.

inputParameters.name: USID
inputParameters.description: User ID of the user whose data is returned.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number used as the user's default company.

outputParameters.name: DIVI
outputParameters.description: Division used as the user's default division within the company.

outputParameters.name: LANC
outputParameters.description: System language used for the user's interface and documents.

outputParameters.name: DTFM
outputParameters.description: Date format used when displaying dates for the user.

outputParameters.name: DCFM
outputParameters.description: Decimal format used when displaying numeric values for the user.

outputParameters.name: TIZO
outputParameters.description: Time zone used when presenting date and time information for the user.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Default facility the user is connected to in this company and division.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Default warehouse the user is connected to for inventory and planning in this company and division.

outputParameters.name: CUNO
outputParameters.description: Customer number linked to the user, for example as the user's default customer.

outputParameters.name: DEPT
outputParameters.description: Department code associated with the user, often used as a cost center or reporting dimension.

outputParameters.name: TX40
outputParameters.description: Description for the company and division record connected to the user.

outputParameters.name: CONM
outputParameters.description: Name of the company associated with the user in this record.

outputParameters.name: MNVR
outputParameters.description: Menu version that determines which menu tree is displayed for the user.

outputParameters.name: DFMN
outputParameters.description: Start menu displayed when the user logs in.

outputParameters.name: USID
outputParameters.description: User ID of the user whose data is returned.

outputParameters.name: NAME
outputParameters.description: Full name of the user as stored in M3.

outputParameters.name: EQAL
outputParameters.description: Equipment alias search sequence used when looking up serialized equipment for the user.

outputParameters.name: USTA
outputParameters.description: Current status of the user, such as preliminary, active, or deactivated.

outputParameters.name: EMAL
outputParameters.description: Email address for contacting the user.

outputParameters.name: USTP
outputParameters.description: Classification of the user, for example individual user or group profile.

outputParameters.name: EUID
outputParameters.description: External user ID used to link the M3 user to an external identity provider or system.

outputParameters.name: PHNO
outputParameters.description: Primary telephone number for contacting the user.

outputParameters.name: TFNO
outputParameters.description: Fax number for contacting the user.

outputParameters.name: FRF6
outputParameters.description: User-defined free field 1 for additional user information; not validated by M3.

outputParameters.name: FRF7
outputParameters.description: User-defined free field 2 for additional user information; not validated by M3.

outputParameters.name: FRF8
outputParameters.description: User-defined numeric free field 3 for additional user information; not validated by M3.

outputParameters.name: FADT
outputParameters.description: Date when the user first became active.

outputParameters.name: LADT
outputParameters.description: Date when the user was last active.

outputParameters.name: ULTP
outputParameters.description: License classification of the user for audit and licensing purposes.

outputParameters.name: CSYS
outputParameters.description: External system from which a connected-system user logs in to M3.

outputParameters.name: CHNO
outputParameters.description: Change number for the user record, used internally to control updates.

outputParameters.name: CHN2
outputParameters.description: Change number for the user-per-company/division record, used internally to control updates.

outputParameters.name: DEVD
outputParameters.description: User location or terminal name used to control print file definitions for the user.

outputParameters.name: PROE
outputParameters.description: Profile identifier used to apply a specific product-configuration profile when the user works with configured products.
